decisions.reason: A certified HVAC plate heat exchanger line close to the core offer costs little to keep, and one year of evidence leaves its value too uncertain to justify abandoning the option.
Early signals of strong market share in marine water cooling suggest the option is paying off and merits further commitment.
The marine cooling unit complements the successful box cooler line and is cheap to maintain while its prospects remain uncertain.
A compact oil cooler line built on established capabilities has low holding costs, and there is no evidence yet that its value is unrealizable.
Finned tubes are a component used across the firm's air cooler business, so keeping the option open is inexpensive and strategically useful.
Enhanced tubes support efficiency innovation across the portfolio at low marginal cost, and their value is still being revealed.
